Name: Earthy-Darkwood Recolor for SVE and Extras
Author: DiceHonk
Description:
[b]Earthy-Darkwood Recolor for SVE + Extras[/b]
This is a personal recolor I originally made for myself, now shared for anyone who might enjoy it.
The mod is not 100% complete yet, as I haven’t fully finished the game. You may encounter some inconsistencies or missed spots. Feedback and suggestions are always welcome!
[line]
[b](!) Note:[/b]
Some signs in the preview screenshots are in Russian. Don’t worry - they will only appear if your game is set to Russian. Everything is fine in English.
[line]
Recolors include:
[list]
[*]Buildings [/*]
[*]Trees [/*]
[*]Craftables [/*]
[*]Cutscenes [/*]
[*]Seasonal Enchanted Grove (configurable) [/*]
[*]Various small fixes [/*]
[/list][line]
Extras:
[list]
[*]The gray cat is replaced with my real-life cat, [i]Thomes[/i] (configurable) [/*]
[*]Additional horse variants [/*]
[*]Option to disable ground flower animations [/*]
[*]Russian translations for DNER signs [/*]
[/list][line]
Work in progress:
[list]
[*]Default farm buildings [/*]
[*]Morris' modern house[/*]
[*]More recolors from the base game and SVE requested in the comments [/*]
[/list]
